A plasma grenade is a thrown weapon that appears in all of the Fallout games. Plasma grenades release a burst of ionized plasma gas when detonated, rather than the typical explosion propelling fragments of normal hand grenades. This intense cloud of super-heated plasma can reduce targets to a puddle of green goo. __TOC__
